calibration_notes: Chosen mat is the END-of-experiment wand (2024-01-25, 281 points). It is what the
2024 run used, and it reproduces the archived `calibration file.h5` to 3e-5 --
i.e. to the dltCoefs CSV's 5-significant-digit rounding. Leave-one-out reprojection
against a built h5: [2.81, 3.73, 3.49, 3.03] px (a movie FAILs above 15).
- `easywand_24_1*` -- start-of-experiment wand; 8.56 px on cam3, measurably worse.
- `easy_wand_25_1_skip_15*` -- same day, 95 points vs 281; equivalent, no reason to prefer.
- `distortion included/` -- solved with distortionMode=2. Its DLT is only valid on pixels
first undistorted by the cam*Tforms.mat maps, and this pipeline has no undistortion
